title: Commitment Velocity Lab — per-minute smoothing, burst shaping, and tiered SLA mapping
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: Customers with spiky traffic are either overpaying for reserved GPUs or suffering throttled throughput when they hit limits. We lack a fine-grained commitment product that lets customers buy a small reservation and rely on elastic shaped burst credits with predictable billing and SLA mapping.

Goal: Prototype a Commitment Velocity product variant that combines (a) a per-minute smoothing reserve allocation, (b) burst credit pool that is consumed by surge traffic and replenished over time, and (c) explicit SLA ladders that map to p99 latency bands and QoS fallbacks. The experiment should quantify unit economics ($/token), revenue predictability, and incidence of SLA fallthroughs.

Hypothesis: A per-minute smoothing model plus an explicit burst credit allocator will reduce effective over-provisioning for medium-size customers by >20% while keeping perceived availability / p99 latency within existing P1 tiers for 95% of traffic spikes.

Key metrics: committed ARR, incremental revenue from burst usage, effective utilization (GPU-hours / committed GPU-hours), p50/p95/p99 latency during spikes, rate of manual escalation / support tickets related to capacity, and legal/sales objections in RFPs.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Launch experiment in sandbox with 3 pilot customers and simulated traffic patterns (steady, diurnal spike, sudden burst) within 6 weeks.
A2: Instrument cost model that reports effective $/token and GPU-hour utilization for committed vs burst usage at 1h granularity.

A3: SLA ladder definitions documented and enforced by routing policy: bronze (best-effort burst), silver (guaranteed burst up to X tokens/min with throttled fallback), gold (hard p99 latency target with preemptive fallback to compatible model variant).
A4: Legal / Security QnA completed for pilot contract and redlines captured; no unresolved enterprise legal blockers for >$250k/yr deals.
A5: Internal Console dashboard widgets for per-customer burst credit balance, replenishment rate, and predictive exhaustion alerting.
A6: Experiment paper with results and recommendation to either promote to beta or iterate on credit parameters.
A7: Post-pilot runbook for sales and support including pricing calculator and gating rules for upgrade paths.
